## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit message is a [conventional commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for any change in behaviour
- [ ] The README, `docs/` and ARCHITECTURE.md are updated if a flag, default, API field or chart value has changed
